harness.note: the real controller machine code over scripted pad input and a scripted clock; UI, sound and pad-read calls replaced by recorders. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: Tidus's Swordplay: the marker bar, the window and the result for scripted presses (the frame a press lands in).
notes: in.cat is the Overdrive family byte (0x20 Spiral Cut, 0x30 Slice and Dice, 0x40 Energy Rain, 0x50 Blitz Ace); in.pal is the PAL tick-rate flag (1: 25 ticks a second).
in.presses are the controller frames (counted from 1 in the input state) on which the pad word has bit 0x20; out.frame is the frame the controller ended in; out.misses the presses outside the window.
out.aBits and out.bBits are the float32 bit patterns of the timer value A and the limit B passed to the result entry (0x7b0470); out.grade is 1 for a hit and 0 for the limit running out.
out.markers (where present) is the marker position before each frame, from frame 1.
class geometry holds what the real set-up wrote: bar x0 and width, window lo, hi and width, marker start, speed and the limit B.
name: minigame_swordplay
